author: thomreis
body:
#### PR description:

This PR adds ECAL Phase 2 digis sample ratio histograms to the ECAL Phase 2 digis validation. The ratio of the samples before and after the maximum samples to the maximum sample is used for the LD spike tagging algorithm and these histograms will allow to verify the weights for the LD algorithm.

#### PR validation:

Ran WF 34434.612 and verified the new histograms in the DQM.
title: Add ECAL Phase 2 digi sample ratio plots to digis validation
